lines.en: label sarabar25:
scene barnight
I make my way to the bar.
lines.zh: 我往酒吧走去。

lines.en: No one is there.
lines.zh: 里面一个人都没有。

lines.en: Though, I imagine that’s on account of the sign on the door saying they’re closed for the night.
lines.zh: 不过我想，这大概是因为门上挂着「今晚休息」的牌子。

lines.en: I’m not sure why Sara chose now to take a night off when she’s finally [[kind of] on the cusp of turning things around for the place.
lines.zh: 我不明白 Sara 为什么挑在这个时候休息——明明这地方终于[[kind of]要起死回生了。

lines.en: But I guess I’m not one to spend too much time questioning her decisions when she’s made so many poor ones in the past that they’re starting to lose their novelty.
lines.zh: 不过她过去做过的烂决定实在太多，多到已经开始不新鲜了，我想我也没资格花太多时间去质疑她的决定。

lines.en: Regardless, I doubt she’s far.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我猜她没走远。

lines.en: In fact, knowing her, she’s probably upstairs getting drunk...or masturbating to pictures of me as we speak.
lines.zh: 事实上，按我对她的了解，她这会儿大概正在楼上喝醉……或者正对着我的照片自慰。

lines.en: I’m not sure where she’d get any, considering I don’t think I’ve posed for a photo even once since waking up here-
lines.zh: 我不知道她从哪儿弄来的照片，毕竟自从在这儿醒来之后，我好像连一张照片都没拍过——

lines.en: But Ayane’s sure had no problem procuring images of me, so maybe Sara just bought them from her?
lines.zh: 可 Ayane 弄到我的照片倒是毫无难度，所以也许 Sara 是从她那儿买的？

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: I’m done standing around down here, though.
lines.zh: 不过我可不想再在楼下站着了。

lines.en: If I’m going to come all the way over to a failing bar in the middle of the night, I’m at least going to get something out of it.
lines.zh: 既然大半夜专程跑到一家快倒闭的酒吧来，我总得捞点什么回去。

lines.en: And whether that be a blowjob or just some quality time with a friendly neighborhood MILF, I’m sure that whatever happens will be, at the bare minimum, worth walking a few miles.
lines.zh: 不管最后是个口交，还是只是和邻家那位熟女度过一段高质量时光，我敢肯定，不管发生什么，至少值我这走的好几公里路。

lines.en: scene black
The stairs creak the same way they always do, as I’m sure it’s been decades since this building has received any sort of renovation.
lines.zh: 楼梯还是老样子吱呀作响——我敢说这栋楼已经几十年没翻修过了。

lines.en: And I’m sure it’ll be a few decades more until it is renovated (If Sara even still owns it by then).
lines.zh: 而且我敢说，再等它翻修还得再过几十年（如果到那时 Sara 还拥有它的话）。

lines.en: But stairs aren’t all that important.
lines.zh: 不过楼梯也没那么重要。

lines.en: You can let them rot and decay and still manage to make your way up just by stepping around all of the soft spots.
lines.zh: 你就算任它腐烂，只要绕开那些松软的地方，照样能走上去。

lines.en: The worst case scenario is that your leg will bust through an old plank and maybe tear some skin off or rip your pants in the process-
lines.zh: 最坏的情况无非是腿踩穿一块旧木板，顺带蹭掉点皮、或者把裤子撕破——

lines.en: But you’ll still get to where you’re trying to go.
lines.zh: 但你终究还是能到你想去的地方。

lines.en: Until you don’t, that is.
lines.zh: 直到你到不了为止。

lines.en: But I don’t know why I’m telling you this.
lines.zh: 不过我不知道自己为什么要跟你说这些。

lines.en: I ascend.
lines.zh: 我上楼。

lines.en: scene saranewapt1
I walk into Sara’s place to find that she must have taken the liberty of redecorating recently.
lines.zh: 走进 Sara 的家，我发现她最近大概是自作主张重新布置了一番。

lines.en: There’s some sort of movie on her television (Which also looks rather new), but I can’t be bothered to figure out what it is since I’m too busy taking in the rest of the sights.
lines.zh: 电视里在放某部电影（那台电视看起来也挺新），不过我懒得去搞清楚是什么片子，因为我正忙着打量其他的东西。

lines.en: It’s warm inside- much warmer than in the corridor that carried me here.
lines.zh: 屋里很暖和——比送我上来的那条走廊暖和多了。

lines.en: And the residual scent of old alcohol and vomit has been replaced by a sweeter smell of cinnamon and...some other indiscernible spice.
lines.zh: 残留的陈旧酒味和呕吐物味不见了，取而代之的是一股更甜的肉桂香，还有……某种分辨不出的香料味。

lines.en: Sara locks eyes with me, not feeling the need to say hello as, apparently, I’m just welcome to intrude on her privacy whenever I want now-
lines.zh: Sara 和我四目相对，连招呼都懒得打——看来现在我随时随地都可以闯进她的私人空间了——

lines.en: But Sana doesn’t react. Or perhaps it’s more like she doesn’t notice.
lines.zh: 可 Sana 没有反应。或者说，更像是她没注意到。

lines.en: She just keeps her eyes centered on the movie that I can’t be bothered to watch and attempts to either fade into obscurity or simply just enjoy some rare time alone with her mother.
lines.zh: 她只是盯着那部我懒得看的电影，试图要么让自己隐身，要么单纯享受这难得的、和母亲独处的时光。

lines.en: I don’t think I should be here right now.
lines.zh: 我觉得我现在不该在这儿。

lines.en: : Oh, good. I was worried that I was going to have to get up.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。我还怕我得自己起来呢。

lines.en: : Can you pour me another glass of wine? There’s an open bottle on the counter over there.
lines.zh: : 能再给我倒杯酒吗？那边台子上有一瓶开着的。

lines.en: : Also, any compliments regarding my super awesome interior design skills are welcome.
lines.zh: : 另外，欢迎夸奖我超厉害的室内设计水平。

lines.en: : I was in the mood for a little spring cleaning earlier and, well, one thing led to a whole bunch of other things that led to this place looking almost brand new.
lines.zh: : 我之前来了点春季大扫除的兴致，然后嘛，一件事接着一件事，最后这地方看起来简直焕然一新。

lines.en: : We don’t...even get Spring here, though...
lines.zh: : 可我们这儿……根本就没有春天啊……

lines.en: : If I didn’t know better, I’d think you just bought a whole new place.
lines.zh: : 要不是我心里有数，我会以为你干脆换了个新家。

lines.en: : Less talking, more pouring.
lines.zh: : 少说话，多倒酒。

lines.en: : I know you’re not much of a wine guy, but feel free to help yourself to some as well. You know, as thanks for your service and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不太喝葡萄酒，不过你也可以自己来点。就当是……对你服务的感谢什么的。

lines.en: scene saranewapt2
: Better idea- how about I just block your view of the TV instead?
lines.zh: : 我有个更好的主意——我干脆把你的电视挡上怎么样？

lines.en: : All those discounted drinks and exceptional service and this is how you repay me?
lines.zh: : 那些打折的酒、那些一流的服务，你就是这么报答我的？

lines.en: : Oh well. I can just not drink.
lines.zh: : 行吧。那我不喝就是了。

lines.en: : Or, you know, help yourself instead of relying on someone else to do your bidding.
lines.zh: : 或者，你知道的，自己动手，别指望别人替你跑腿。

lines.en: scene saranewapt3
: But if I get up, there’s a chance you’ll steal my seat and ruin our wonderful and extremely overdue mother-daughter night.
lines.zh: : 可我要是起来，你就有可能抢走我的位置，毁掉我们这场美好又早就该办一次的母女之夜。

lines.en: : You know this...couch can fit a lot more than just the two of us...right?
lines.zh: : 你知道这张……沙发能坐下的远不止我们两个吧？

lines.en: scene saranewapt4
: But then I’ll be further away from you and won’t be able to constantly admire how adorable you’ve become!
lines.zh: : 可那样我就离你更远了，就不能一直欣赏你变得多可爱了！

lines.en: : Umm...Sensei...I’m...pretty sure the sign downstairs said that we were closed...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sensei……我……挺确定楼下的牌子上写的是「休息中」……

lines.en: : Yeah, I know.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道。

lines.en: : So...you came in anyway?...
lines.zh: : 所以……你还是进来了？……

lines.en: : And then...proceeded to...just come upstairs?...
lines.zh: : 然后……还……直接上楼了？……

lines.en: : I didn’t think that sign applied to me since I’m basically just another employee here at this point.
lines.zh: : 我以为那块牌子对我无效，毕竟事到如今我基本也算这儿的另一个员工了。

lines.en: scene saranewapt5
: What kind of employee won’t allow their boss to drink on the job?! Or wipe down tables?! Or restock the cooler?! Or do literally anything ever?!
lines.zh: : 哪有员工不让老板上班喝酒的？！还不让擦桌子？！不让补货到冷藏柜？！什么都他妈不让干？！

lines.en: : The same kind who’s apparently intruding on what’s supposed to be an...important night, I think?
lines.zh: : 大概是那种正在打扰一个……重要夜晚的员工？我觉得？

lines.en: scene saranewapt6
: Yeah. But if anyone was going to intrude, I’m glad it was you.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过既然总得有人来打扰，我很高兴是你。

lines.en: : Especially since I’d say you’re closer to being Sana’s dad than an employee of the Sakaki-bar-a at this point.
lines.zh: : 尤其是事到如今，我觉得你与其说是「Sakaki-bar-a」的员工，不如说更接近 Sana 的爸爸。

lines.en: : Can you...please stop saying that every time we’re in the same room together?...
lines.zh: : 你能不能……别每次我俩在同一个房间里都这么说？……

lines.en: : But if I keep saying it over and over again, Sensei will eventually start believing it and we’ll finally have a full family again.
lines.zh: : 可只要我一直说、一直说，Sensei 总有一天会信的，那我们就有了一个完整的家了。

lines.en: scene saranewapt7
: You could finally know what it’s like to have a male authority figure in your life, Sana!
lines.zh: : Sana，你终于能知道生命里有个男性长辈是什么感觉了！

lines.en: : I don’t even have a...female authority figure in my life...
lines.zh: : 我连个……女性长辈都没有……

lines.en: : I can not allow this conversation to proceed without informing you that no amount of words will make me just suddenly believe I’m a member of this family.
lines.zh: 我得插一句，不管你们说多少话，都不可能让我突然就相信自己是这个家的一员。

lines.en: scene saranewapt8
: I wouldn’t be so sure if I was you. For all we know, some stuff could happen out of nowhere that makes you change your mind entirely.
lines.zh: : 换作是我，我可不会这么肯定。说不定哪天突然发生点什么，你就彻底改主意了。

lines.en: : Doubtful.
lines.zh: : 不太可能。

lines.en: : I’m just saying, it wouldn’t be the first time a teacher fell victim to my feminine wiles. It’s not like there’s no precedent for this.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，老师拜倒在我女性魅力之下这种事又不是第一次了。这又不是没有先例。

lines.en: : Just give me a little warning in advance if you decide to leave me for someone else so I can actually try and prepare this time and not have to raise Sana on my own.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是决定为了别人离开我，记得提前给我个预警，好让我这次真的做点准备，不用一个人把 Sana 拉扯大。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Sana’s able to raise herself at this point.
lines.zh: : 我敢说 Sana 现在都能自己把自己拉扯大了。

lines.en: : Well, apart from the whole still being terrified of talking to other people part.
lines.zh: : 嗯，除了她还是怕跟别人说话这一点。

lines.en: scene saranewapt9
: Hey! I’ve gotten a lot better since you started helping me!
lines.zh: : 喂！你开始帮我之后我已经好多了！

lines.en: : True. But that doesn’t change the fact that you’re still exponentially worse than virtually everyone other than like...Yasu and maybe Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 没错。可这改变不了你还是比几乎所有人都差上好几倍的事实——除了……Yasu，也许还有 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : You have improved a lot, Sana. Which means that Sensei has already done a lot more for you than your real father ever did.
lines.zh: : 你进步很大，Sana。这说明 Sensei 为你做的，已经比你亲爸做过的多太多了。

lines.en: scene saranewapt10
: Why do you have to keep comparing the two of them?...Why can’t Sensei just be Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你为什么非要把他俩放在一起比？……Sensei 就只能是 Sensei，不行吗？

lines.en: : I would also like to remain Sensei if that is at all possible.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，我也想继续只是 Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m not trying to compare them. I’m just saying that-
lines.zh: : 我没有要比较他们。我只是说——

lines.en: scene saranewapt11
: Well, a family of two can feel pretty lonely at times.
lines.zh: : 怎么说呢，两个人的家有时候会挺寂寞的。

lines.en: : I love spending time with just us, but I miss the feeling of there being more sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我很喜欢只有我们俩的时光，可有时候我会怀念「家里还有别人」的那种感觉。

lines.en: : And Sensei’s the closest we’ve had to...
lines.zh: : 而 Sensei 是我们拥有过的、最接近……

lines.en: scene saranewapt12
: A...male family member since-
lines.zh: : 一个……男性家庭成员的人，自从——

lines.en: : Since my dad left, I know.
lines.zh: : 从我爸走后，我知道。

lines.en: : I just...don’t think it’s right to drag him into that without...considering how he feels first...
lines.zh: : 我只是……觉得不该把他拖进来，而不先……考虑他的感受……

lines.en: You know, this might be presumptuous of me, but I’m pretty sure Sara wasn’t alluding to Sana’s father just now.
lines.zh: 我这么说可能有点自作多情，但我挺确定 Sara 刚才指的不是 Sana 的父亲。

lines.en: Which, of course, would mean that her daughter was going out on a limb to protect her- the same way I’m sure she’s done plenty of times in the past.
lines.zh: 那当然就意味着，她的女儿正在冒险护着她——就像我敢肯定她过去已经做过无数次那样。

lines.en: The two of them can’t keep running forever, though.
lines.zh: 可她们俩不可能永远这么逃避下去。

lines.en: There has to come a day, for Sara especially, when the two of them accept what they went through and finally stop putting bandages over a gash that obviously needs stitches.
lines.zh: 总有一天——尤其是对 Sara 来说——她们得接受自己经历过的一切，别再给一道明明需要缝针的伤口贴创可贴了。

lines.en: The probability of that wound getting infected grows greater every day, and there’d be no point in meetings like this at all if one of them had that infection spread to their heart or their brain or something.
lines.zh: 那道伤口感染的概率一天比一天大；要是她们中谁的感染扩散到心脏还是脑子什么的，像今天这样的见面就一点意义都没有了。

lines.en: I’m not a doctor. I don’t really know where infections spread to- or even how they start in the first place.
lines.zh: 我又不是医生。我真不知道感染会扩散到哪儿——甚至不知道它一开始是怎么来的。

lines.en: I just know how easy it is for them to fester.
lines.zh: 我只知道它有多容易化脓。

lines.en: I know a little too well.
lines.zh: 我知道得太清楚了。

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Since your dad left.
lines.zh: : 从你爸走后。

lines.en: scene saranewapt13
: You know, he was a real jerk! Like, it’s one thing to knock up a teenage girl, but to abandon her and force her to be a single parent before she can even legally rent a car?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，他就是个彻头彻尾的混蛋！把未成年女孩搞大肚子是一回事，可抛下她、逼她在连合法租车都还不够格的时候就当起了单亲妈妈？

lines.en: : What the fuck is that?!
lines.zh: : 这他妈算什么？！

lines.en: : Do you...even know how to drive?
lines.zh: : 你……会开车吗？

lines.en: : No! But still!
lines.zh: : 不会！可那不是重点！

lines.en: scene saranewapt14
: Ugh. And he was so great at first, too.
lines.zh: : 唉。而且他一开始还特别好呢。

lines.en: : Well, great is probably being a little too generous. But I genuinely thought he was right for me and that all of the suspicions I had over the years were just me being paranoid.
lines.zh: : 嗯，说「特别好」可能有点夸张了。可我是真心觉得他适合我，也真心以为这些年所有的疑心都只是我在多想。

lines.en: : Wait a second, you suspected he was seeing other people and still managed to...get as far into the relationship as you did?
lines.zh: : 等等，你都怀疑他在外面有人了，还让这段关系走到了那么深？

lines.en: scene saranewapt15
: Yeah. But you’ve gotta remember- I wasn’t really in the greatest place when I was in high school.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过你得记得——我上高中的时候状态本来就不太好。

lines.en: : I thought that being paranoid and...not feeling confident about anything was just how teenage girls were supposed to feel back then.
lines.zh: : 我以为疑神疑鬼、对什么都没自信，就是那个年纪的女生该有的感觉。

lines.en: : And when you’re that age and dating an adult, those feelings wind up getting even bigger than how they started out.
lines.zh: : 而你在那个年纪、又和一个成年人交往，这些感觉就会变得比最初还要大得多。

lines.en: scene saranewapt16
: Of course, he’d always assure me that I was the only one who mattered to him and that he’d never think of seeing someone else-
lines.zh: : 当然，他总是向我保证，我是他唯一在乎的人，他绝不会想去找别人——

lines.en: : But I’m sure that’s exactly what he told the other girl! Or...girls.
lines.zh: : 可我敢肯定他对另一个女人也是这么说的！或者……女人们。

lines.en: : I don’t even know if it was just one person or not.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不知道到底是不是只有一个人。

lines.en: : Hell, for all I know, he could have been screwing his entire class back then.
lines.zh: : 操，搞不好他当时把自己整个班的女生都睡了个遍。

lines.en: : Sorry for the language, Sana. Your mother’s getting pissed off.
lines.zh: : 抱歉说脏话了，Sana。你妈妈正在气头上。

lines.en: : Wow. This guy sounds like a real scumbag.
lines.zh: : 哇。这家伙听起来真是个彻头彻尾的人渣。

lines.en: He also sounds like me.
lines.zh: 他听起来也挺像我的。

lines.en: But I guess those two things are close to interchangeable at this point.
lines.zh: 不过我想，事到如今这两样东西也差不多可以划等号了。

lines.en: scene saranewapt17
: You know...I kind of wonder what he’s up to sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……我有时会有点好奇他现在在干什么。

lines.en: : Not because I want to see him or anything, I just want to know whether or not he’s happy with the mess he made of his life.
lines.zh: : 不是因为我想见他什么的，我只是想知道，他把自己的人生搞成这副烂摊子，到底过得开不开心。

lines.en: : And also because I’d want to point out to whatever girl, or girls, that he wound up with that he’s an unfaithful jackass who walked out on the cutest daughter in the world...as well as her super cool mom.
lines.zh: : 还有，我想告诉最后跟他在一起的那个女人——或者女人们——他是个不忠的混蛋，抛下了全世界最可爱的女儿……还有一个超酷的妈妈。

lines.en: : Um...th...thank you?...
scene saranewapt18
: Don’t mention it, sweetie.
lines.zh: : 别客气，亲爱的。

lines.en: : I love you. And I just want you to have the best life possible. And I...
lines.zh: : 我爱你。我只想让你过上最好的人生。而我……

lines.en: : Well...Sometimes, I don’t think I’m able to give you that sort of life on my own.
lines.zh: : 嗯……有时候，我会觉得自己一个人没法给你那样的人生。

lines.en: : Um...that’s...uhh...
scene saranewapt19
: But I guess I can’t just rope Sensei into being your new dad if that’s not something he already wants.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，要是 Sensei 本来就不想，我也不能硬把他拽来当你新爸爸。

lines.en: : But that’s still not going to stop me from looking at him as the closest thing we have to another family member right now.
lines.zh: : 可这也不妨碍我把他当成我们现在最接近「另一个家庭成员」的人。

lines.en: : Really? I’m the closest thing? Because you’ve known Haruka and Maki significantly longer than you’ve known me.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我是最接近的？你和 Haruka、Maki 认识的时间可比认识我长多了。

lines.en: scene saranewapt20
: True. But my daughter doesn’t like either of them even half as much as she likes you.
lines.zh: : 没错。可我女儿对她们俩的喜欢，连对你的二分之一都不到。

lines.en: : M-Mom!
: And, between the three of us, I don’t like either of them as much as I like you either.
lines.zh: : 而且就我们三个人之间说，我对她们俩的喜欢也不如对你是。

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
I would sure hope not.
lines.zh: 我当然希望不是。

lines.en: : Does it really matter how long I’ve known you? Am I not allowed to like you as much as I do until a certain date and time?
lines.zh: : 我认识你多久真有那么重要吗？难道非得到某个特定的日期和时间，我才有资格这么喜欢你？

lines.en: : Because if that’s the case, tell me when and I’ll mark it on my calendar right now. I’m serious.
lines.zh: : 如果真是这样，你告诉我什么时候，我现在就记到日历上。我是认真的。

lines.en: : S-Stop saying embarrassing stuff like that! It’s weird and neither of us like it!
lines.zh: : 别——别再说这种让人害臊的话了！很奇怪，我俩都不喜欢！

lines.en: : I mean, I didn’t say-
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我又没说——

lines.en: : It’s weird and none of us like it!
lines.zh: : 很奇怪，我们谁都不喜欢！

lines.en: scene saranewapt21
: Okay, you go. It’s your turn to say embarrassing stuff to Sensei so he’s forced to choose which one of us he wants to be closer to.
lines.zh: : 好，该你了。轮到你去对 Sensei 说点让人害臊的话了，好逼他选到底想跟我们谁更亲近。

lines.en: : I think I’d rather just...not say anything...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我还是……什么都不说比较好……

lines.en: : And I think I’d rather never be forced into making a choice as horrible as that.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得我还是永远别被迫做那么可怕的选择比较好。

lines.en: : I will gladly accept both of you, but keep you far enough away that you can not, officially or unofficially, indoctrinate me into the Sakakibara family.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意接纳你们两个，但会跟你们保持足够的距离，好让你们无论正式还是非正式，都没法把我洗脑成 Sakakibara 家的一员。

lines.en: : I refuse to be a part of a dynasty as bad at naming things as you two.
lines.zh: : 我拒绝加入一个起名水平跟你们俩一样烂的家族。

lines.en: scene saranewapt22
: I didn’t...really have anything to do with naming the bar...
lines.zh: : 酒吧的名字……其实跟我没什么关系……

lines.en: : But...thank you for...staying away...
lines.zh: : 不过……谢谢你……保持距离……

lines.en: : Leave my bar alone. What did it ever do to you besides give you a place to spend your nights instead of at home with your [niece]?
lines.zh: : 别 diss 我的酒吧。它除了给你一个不用回家陪 [niece]、能消磨夜晚的地方之外，还对你做过什么？

lines.en: : It also refused to serve me tonight, but I guess I’m willing to overlook that on account of you two playing catch-up or whatever.
lines.zh: : 它今晚还拒绝招待我，不过看在你俩在补母女时光什么的份上，我就不计较了。

lines.en: scene saranewapt23
: Well...we were playing catch-up...but I think I only have a little while left until I have to go back to the dorms...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们是在补……不过我想再过一会儿我就得回宿舍了……

lines.en: : That’s right. You only had until the end of the movie, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 对哦。你只能待到电影结束，是吧？

lines.en: : What happens if we rewind it? I have the cool kind of cable now where you can actually do that.
lines.zh: : 那要是我们倒带呢？我现在装的可是那种能倒带的高级有线电视。

lines.en: : Would that mean we can just keep sending you back in time until you don’t have to leave anymore?
lines.zh: : 那是不是就能一直把你送回过去，直到你再也不用走了？

lines.en: : No, Mom...that’s...not what it would mean...
lines.zh: : 不是的，妈妈……那……不是这个意思……

lines.en: : My bad for showing up and throwing a wrench in your plans. Just leave a note for me next time if you don’t want me coming up.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我冒出来搅了你们的计划。下次不想让我上楼，给我留张条就行。

lines.en: : I...kind of thought the “We’re closed” sign was...that note...
lines.zh: : 我……还以为「休息中」那块牌子……就是那张条……

lines.en: scene saranewapt24
: It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没事。

lines.en: : Sure, Sana and I don’t really get many chances to spend time alone outside of the bar anymore...
lines.zh: : 确实，我和 Sana 现在很少有机会在酒吧以外的地方单独待着了……

lines.en: : But I’m hoping that might be able to change some day...
lines.zh: : 不过我希望有一天能有所改变……

lines.en: : Business has been picking back up and, who knows? Maybe in a few months, I’ll be able to hire another new employee so Sana and I take some time off together?
lines.zh: : 生意正在回暖，谁知道呢？也许再过几个月，我就能再雇个新员工，好让我和 Sana 一起休个假？

lines.en: : Just hire Kaori full time. I’m beginning to think there are ten or eleven of her that just share the same stream of consciousness.
lines.zh: : 直接全职雇 Kaori 吧。我开始怀疑这世上有十个还是十一个 Kaori，共享着同一条意识流。

lines.en: : There is no other way she’d be able to be in so many places at once, so I think that might actually be what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 不然她根本没法同时出现在那么多地方，所以我觉得真相大概就是这样。

lines.en: : She’s actually still working for a competitor several nights out of the week, so she can’t be here full-time. But I’d be open to it if she ever leaves that place.
lines.zh: : 其实她一周还有几个晚上在竞争对手那儿干活，所以没法在这儿全职。不过她要是哪天离开那儿，我很乐意。

lines.en: : Well, hopefully if you’re lucky, it will be swallowed by a sinkhole and things will just automatically get better for you.
lines.zh: : 那祝你好运，希望那地方被天坑吞了，你的日子就自动变好了。

lines.en: : It happened for me, to some extent, so it’s not impossible.
lines.zh: : 我就多少碰上过这种事，所以也不是不可能。

lines.en: : Though I guess “better” would be up for debate depending on exactly what you’re trying to get out of-
lines.zh: : 不过「变好」这个词还有待商榷，要看你到底想从中得到——

lines.en: : Shh...
: They're about to...blow up the Death Star...
lines.zh: : 他们马上要……炸掉死星了……

lines.en: scene black
Sara and I humor Sana and decide to stay quiet for the rest of the movie.
lines.zh: 我和 Sara 顺着 Sana 的意思，决定在剩下的电影里保持安静。

lines.en: if bar50 == True:
It doesn’t last much longer and, once it’s over, Sana gathers her things and turns to look at me before heading to the door.
lines.zh: 电影没剩多久就结束了；一结束，Sana 收拾好东西，转向我看了我一眼，才往门口走。

lines.en: : Umm...S-Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……S-Sensei？……

lines.en: : Yeah? What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？

lines.en: : Can I...umm...
: Can I talk to you for a minute?...
lines.zh: : 我能和你聊一会儿吗？……

lines.en: : In...private?...
: Oh, yeah. Sure.
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。没问题。

lines.en: Sara pretends to not hear this and, very surprisingly, actually gives her daughter a little bit of privacy for once.
lines.zh: Sara 假装没听见，而且非常难得地，真的给了女儿一点私人空间。

lines.en: As such, I follow Sana to the foyer to see what it is she wants to talk to me about.
lines.zh: 于是我跟着 Sana 走到门厅，看她到底想跟我说什么。

lines.en: scene saranewapt25
The two of us stand there for a moment in what isn’t technically silence due to the background noise of the television- but it sure as Hell feels like it.
lines.zh: 我俩在那儿站了一会儿；严格来说不算安静，因为还有电视的声音——但那感觉简直跟死寂一样。

lines.en: I’m not the one who summoned this meeting, though, so I’ll be damned if I’m the one to break the silence.
lines.zh: 不过又不是我发起的这场会面，所以打死我也不会先开口打破沉默。

lines.en: Go on, Sana.
lines.zh: 说吧，Sana。

lines.en: Air out your worries to me so that I may either discard them as I see fit-
lines.zh: 把你的烦恼倒给我，好让我要么按我的判断把它们丢掉——

lines.en: Or give you a shoulder to lean your head on (Likely with the help of a stepping stool).
lines.zh: 要么给你一个能把头靠上来的肩膀（大概率还得配个垫脚凳）。

lines.en: : So...do you remember the...last time the two of us were up here together?...
lines.zh: : 那么……你还记得……上次我俩一起在楼上吗？……

lines.en: : Obviously. You freaking out on me isn’t something that’s particularly easy to forget.
lines.zh: : 当然。你冲我发飙那次可没那么容易忘。

lines.en: scene saranewapt26
: I asked my mom about...what I found...
lines.zh: : 我问了我妈……我找到的那些东西……

lines.en: : The sex toy? Or the things you yelled at me for?
lines.zh: : 是那个性玩具？还是你冲我吼的那些东西？

lines.en: scene saranewapt27
: O-Obviously the...things I yelled at you for!
lines.zh: : 当——当然是……我冲你吼的那些东西！

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Then what?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: scene saranewapt28
: Well...
: She...told me they...weren’t yours...
lines.zh: : 她……告诉我那些……不是你的……

lines.en: : And then she...threw them all away because she said they were old and...
lines.zh: : 然后她……把它们全扔了，说那些东西过期了，而且……

lines.en: : Umm...did you know that...that those things can...expire?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你知道……那些东西会……过期吗？……

lines.en: : Yes, and I feel very bad for anyone who holds on to them so long that they actually do.
lines.zh: : 知道，而且我非常同情那些把这种东西留到真的过期的人。

lines.en: : Y-Yeah...so...
lines.zh: : 是……是啊……所以……

lines.en: : I’m...sorry again for...accusing you of...something you probably didn’t do...
lines.zh: : 我……又想为……指责了你……你可能根本没做过的事……道歉……

lines.en: : Probably? So I’m still not off the hook yet?
lines.zh: : 可能？那我还算是没脱身咯？

lines.en: scene saranewapt29
Sana looks at me and goes quiet.
lines.zh: Sana 看着我，安静了下来。

lines.en: Quieter than she normally is, I mean.
lines.zh: 我是说，比她平时还要安静。

lines.en: And, strangely enough, the volume of the TV dies down at this exact moment, actually sending the two of us into true silence for a few seconds.
lines.zh: 奇怪的是，就在这时电视的声音也低了下去，让我俩真的陷入了几秒钟的寂静。

lines.en: Within these few seconds, Sana bares her heart to me.
lines.zh: 就在这几秒里，Sana 向我剖白了真心。

lines.en: : You’ll never be off the hook, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你永远都别想脱身，Sensei。

lines.en: : Not until my mom cuts the line.
lines.zh: : 除非我妈妈把线剪断。

lines.en: : And even then, you’ll have to swim away with it dangling off of your lip, hanging there until the day you die.
lines.zh: : 到那时，你也得带着那根挂在嘴上的线游走，让它一直挂到你死的那天。

lines.en: : I have to leave now.
lines.zh: : 我得走了。

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 还有……

lines.en: : And I want you to come with me.
lines.zh: : 而且我想让你跟我一起走。

lines.en: : But you won’t, will you?
lines.zh: : 可你不会的，对吧？

lines.en: scene saranewapt30
: I’m fine with not having a dad, you know.
lines.zh: : 其实，没有爸爸我也无所谓。

lines.en: scene saranewapt31
And just like that, Sana leaves.
lines.zh: 就这样，Sana 走了。

lines.en: scene black
It’s a strange note to part on, but I think I understand what she means.
lines.zh: 这个收尾有点奇怪，但我想我明白她的意思。

lines.en: And it’s not all that different from what she’s been slowly but surely trying to help me understand for a while now.
lines.zh: 这和她这段时间一直在慢慢、却坚定地想让我明白的东西，没什么两样。

lines.en: She has no intention of ever accepting the life her mother wants for her. Or, for us, rather.
lines.zh: 她根本不打算接受她母亲为她规划的人生。或者说，为我们规划的人生。

lines.en: I’m not sure when I started being included, but it’s pretty much inevitable that it’ll just keep going on forever at this point.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己是从什么时候被算进去的，但事到如今，这大概只会一直继续下去。

lines.en: Sana doesn’t want me to be here right now-
lines.zh: Sana 现在并不想让我在这儿——

lines.en: But she knows that it’s not her place to drag me along with her.
lines.zh: 可她知道，她没有立场把我一起拖走。

lines.en: And so she’s trusting me, something I wouldn’t recommend to anyone, to not do something that will hurt her.
lines.zh: 所以她选择相信我——这可是我不会向任何人推荐的选项——相信我不会做出伤害她的事。

lines.en: Or-
lines.zh: 或者——

lines.en: At least that’s how I’m interpreting it.
lines.zh: 至少我是这么理解的。

lines.en: But, for all I know-
lines.zh: 不过，说不定——

lines.en: I could very well be wrong.
lines.zh: 我完全可能理解错了。

lines.en: And I could very well hurt her even when I do everything in my power to avoid that.
lines.zh: 而且就算我竭尽全力避免，我还是完全可能伤到她。

lines.en: That’s...just the way things are sometimes.
lines.zh: 有些事……本来就是这样。

lines.en: $ sana_love += 1
$ sarabar25 = True
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
lines.zh: Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]!

lines.en: jump sarabar25p2
else:
It doesn’t last much longer and, once it’s over, Sana gathers her things and heads for the door.
lines.zh: 电影没剩多久就结束了；一结束，Sana 收拾好东西就往门口走。

lines.en: She looks back at me and, strangely enough, in the one second of eye contact that I make with her, it seems like she’s telling me that she trusts me.
lines.zh: 她回头看了我一眼；奇怪的是，在我和她对视的那一秒里，她似乎是在告诉我，她信任我。

lines.en: I’m sure it’s not easy for her to just leave me alone with her mother when she’s fully aware of her feelings for me-
lines.zh: 她完全清楚她母亲对我的感情，却还是把我单独留给母亲——这对她来说肯定不容易——

lines.en: But it’s something she elects to do regardless.
lines.zh: 可她还是选择这么做了。

lines.en: I’m not sure what I did to deserve this, but I’m not about to make a break for the door to see if she’s really okay with leaving two adults alone in a dark room together.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己做了什么配得上这份信任，不过我也不会冲到门口去确认她是不是真能接受把两个成年人单独留在黑屋子里。

lines.en: And hey, maybe it’s something even less exciting?
lines.zh: 而且嘿，也许事情还没那么值得期待？

lines.en: Maybe trust has nothing to do with it and Sana just has absolutely no romantic or sexual feelings for me, making this just an average, everyday goodbye.
lines.zh: 也许根本和信任无关，Sana 只是对我毫无恋爱或性方面的感情，所以这就是一次平平无奇的日常道别。

lines.en: And, if that’s the case-
lines.zh: 而如果是那样的话——

lines.en: So long, Sana.
lines.zh: 再见了，Sana。

lines.en: Have a safe trip home- and don’t think too much about whatever you expect to happen in this room.
lines.zh: 路上小心——也别太去想你以为这个房间里会发生什么。

lines.en: I’m sure that whatever comes next will be something you didn’t really want to be here for anyway.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，接下来发生的事本来就不是你愿意留下来看的。

lines.en: $ sarabar25 = True
jump sarabar25p2
